content:
nina-finance: Flagging a billing dispute from HelixCare (private deployment) — they say platform fee on Feb invoice should be waived due to a planned maintenance migration window. They attached their ops bulletin.
lucas-sales: CNX: talked to their account lead. HelixCare says they notified us via ops@redwood on 2026-02-10 and expected an exemption for the 4h maintenance window. They want full platform fee removed for Feb.
akash-cs: do we have an inbound ticket or recorded approval? I can check support logs and the inbound email archive.
nina-finance: invoice snapshot:
```
INV-2026-210
line 1: reserved_gpu_commit (720h) => $36,000
line 2: platform_fee (private dedicated) => $9,600
line 3: support_enterprise => $3,200
```
customer asks to remove $9.6k platform fee.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-210 created 2026-02-12T09:22Z. Metering: reserved_commit_hours=720 for cust_org=helixcare; maintenance_tag present on pool helix-prod-mig from 2026-02-10T01:00Z to 2026-02-10T05:00Z. No redwood-approved exemption record found.
lucas-sales: Helix forwarded the email they sent to ops@redwood with subject "Planned migration 02/10". No response from Redwood appears in their thread.
fiona-legal: Contract note: SOW §3.4 says "Maintenance windows require prior written approval from Redwood for billing exemption." We need explicit approval to auto-waive.
akash-cs: technical note: pool was in reserved state but traffic was diverted during the 4h window. There was also a brief failover event after the migration where they used burst on-demand nodes for ~1.5h. That on-demand usage is billable and separate.
matt-cfo: proposing compromise: finance can apply a one-time concession equal to the pro-rated platform fee for the verified maintenance window plus a 10% goodwill uplift on the platform line, but not the full line-item removal. Need signoff from legal for precedent.
nina-finance: quick math: platform $9,600 / 720h = $13.33/hr. Verified maintenance 4.0h => pro-rated $53.33. 10% uplift on full platform line = $960. Combined concession if we do both would be $1,013.33 -> round to $1,013.
lucas-sales: customer will push back if we only give $1k vs $9.6k. Suggest we offer $3,000 credit as alternative if they sign a short migration SLA addendum committing to 48h pre-approval with AM.
fiona-legal: we can approve a one-time $3,000 settlement if AM confirms negotiation and we add a documented acceptance email from customer. We should document that this is an exception and update onboarding docs.
matt-cfo: approve up to $3,000 one-time settlement for this case. Finance to issue credit memo and require customer signature to finalize.
nina-finance: will issue credit memo CM-2026-201 for $3,000 pending HelixCare acceptance and signature of migration addendum. Ticket #billing-ops-9012. Will change invoice status to "disputed_pending_settlement".
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-201 created and queued. Ledger not yet adjusted until signed settlement received.
lucas-sales: I'll send the settlement offer to HelixCare and route the migration addendum for signature. Will include clear steps for future pre-approval (ops@redwood + AM approval within 48h).
akash-cs: I'll add detection rule to alert when `migration:*` tags appear and route to ops channel for manual approval.
fiona-legal: I'll draft the addendum language and copy to AMs. Keep a record in the contract bucket.
nina-finance: closing for now  will update when signed. :white_check_mark:
